mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.operator_id=u.id OR o.reviewed_by=u.id OR o.closed_by=u.id OR o.reconciled_by=u.id OR o.reversed_by=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_order s WHERE s.cashier_id=u.id OR s.corrected_by=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stocktake_order s WHERE s.operator_id=u.id OR s.reviewed_by=u.id OR s.closed_by=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.created_by=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.created_by=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement m WHERE m.actor_id=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_suggestion a WHERE a.operator_id=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operation_log l WHERE l.actor_id=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_config c WHERE c.updated_by=u.id)

CAST(u.id AS CHAR) id,u.username,u.real_name,u.phone,u.role_code,r.name role_name,u.enabled,u.created_at,u.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order p WHERE p.operator_id=u.id AND p.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','REJECTED')) unfinished_purchases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_order s WHERE s.operator_id=u.id AND s.status IN ('COUNTING','PENDING','REJECTED')) active_stocktakes, () business_referenced

where.if: AND (CONVERT(u.username USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.code=u.role_code ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.code=u.role_code WHERE u.id=#{id}
SELECT () FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{id}
